name: [Jisa] Feed is silent (connected but no messages)
message:
The daemon is up and the socket is open, but no message has arrived in over 2 minutes. This is the failure mode a process-liveness check cannot see.

Runbook: docs/deploy.md (the daemon reconnects on its own; investigate only if this stays firing).

name: [Jisa] Engine down (stats.json stale)
message: The daemon has stopped rewriting stats.json. Compose restart policy should recover it; if this persists the container is crash-looping.

name: [Jisa] Alert rate anomalous (Datadog's detection vs the engine's)
message:
Datadog's own anomaly detection has flagged the engine's alert rate.

This monitor exists to be compared against the engine's internal conformal layer, which holds a measured 0.0116 false-alarm rate at alpha=0.01. Two independent detectors watching the same signal: when they disagree, one of them is wrong and it is worth knowing which.

name: [Jisa] Feed gap rate climbing
message: trade_id sequence gaps are accumulating: messages are being dropped upstream or the connection is flapping. Correlate with jisa.feed.reconnects.
